aiMetadata.description: Downloads the binary content of a file from Zoho CRM (e.g. a backup or attachment) given its full URL, authenticating with the connected account, and returns it as a stored file. Use when you already hold a Zoho CRM file URL and need its bytes for a later step. Requires the complete URL including the base host; read-only, so repeating the call is safe.
